memo.text: The borrower's case evidence shows $8,971,724 in payments from 'Northstar Industrial Supply Inc', a non-obligor, with circular flows of nearly $9 million
'Meridian Partners LP' has a judgment of $186,746 against it from a synthetic former landlord
'Meridian Partners LP' has two UCC liens, including a second-priority lien on all assets by Prairie Capital Partners LP
The borrower disclosed a subordinated facility with Prairie Capital Partners LP and subsidiaries Prairie Auto Sales LLC and Harbor Auto Sales LLC
The borrower's related companies include Meridian Partners LP, Prairie Auto Sales LLC, and Harbor Auto Sales LLC, all sharing officers or addresses
Could not confirm the exact source of the $9 million circular flow, which may involve linked entities
Ask the borrower: to clarify the relationship with Northstar Industrial Supply Inc and the source of the $9 million circular flow
